title: Singular Bank helps bankers move fast with ChatGPT and Codex
summary_lines: Singular Bank built Singularity, an internal assistant using ChatGPT and Codex to help bankers save 60–90 minutes daily on meeting prep, portfolio analysis, and follow-up.
